rows.en: (Okay! I'm going to pass this, no matter what!)

(No way... I lost the mock battle,
and my official enlistment was riding on it...)
rows.notes: Shared male/female and the S.M.S. (scd_sms_703) branch.

rows.en:
You may have lost the mock battle,
but your moves weren't bad.
R-really?
rows.notes: Shared x4 (Gary here, Klan in scd_sms_703); matches earlier 'R-really?'.

rows.en:
(Phew... I somehow managed to win
the mock battle.)
You moved pretty well out there.

Now then, without further ado, \p...
I'll give you the results of your
final enlistment test!
rows.notes: Shared Gary (New U.N. Forces branch) and Ozma (S.M.S. branch); neutral wording.

rows.en: As of this moment, you...
rows.notes: Sentence cut across rows: kisama wo (you) here, then the next row (c20800 / sms c23997, already finished as 'We welcome you as an official member of S.M.S.!') restarts with 'We welcome you'. Kept 'you...' as a dramatic pause; shared Gary/Ozma.

rows.en:
We welcome you as an official member
of the New U.N. Forces!
rows.notes: Matches the finished S.M.S. twin c23997.

rows.en: So that means...?
Yeah, you passed.
Yaaaaaaaay~~!!
Way to go, Fresh Boy.
Thank you, Luis-san.

Wait, you're congratulating me like it's normal,
but you were in the New U.N. Forces, Luis-san?
That really surprised me.

Ha ha, don't sweat the small stuff,
Fresh Boy.

For now, celebrating your pass comes first.
All right! We're going to karaoke!
Huh!? Karaoke?

I'll sing you a song that'll make your soul shake.
Tonight we burn with passion all night long!

(A-all night...?
But there's no way I can turn him down
with the mood like this...)

Oh, then why don't you come along too,
Captain Gary...
Wait, he's already gone!?
(Captain Gary... He ran away, didn't he...)
Come on, let's go! Fresh Boy!

(Now I've officially been accepted
as a member of the New U.N. Forces.)
rows.notes: Phrased like the finished S.M.S. twin c24009.

rows.en:
(I've got to work hard so I don't hold
everyone back.)

(Phew... I somehow managed to win
the mock battle.)
Way to go, Fresh Girl.

Ha ha, don't sweat the small stuff,
Fresh Girl.
(Captain Gary... He ran away, didn't he...)
Come on, let's go! Fresh Girl!

(Now I've officially been accepted
as a member of the New U.N. Forces.)

(I've got to work hard so I don't hold
everyone back.)

(I don't want to believe it...
The Galaxy fleet was attacked by the Vajra...)

(Their call for rescue cut off partway, too...
I hope they're all right...)

Emergency notice.
Surviving Galaxy ships that escaped the Vajra
have been confirmed. Repeat...
rows.notes: Claire here, a generic Operator in scd_sms_704.

rows.en: (They found surviving Galaxy ships!?)

Hey, \p...
I know how anxious you are, but calm down a little.

We're heading out to rescue the surviving Galaxy ships.
In that state, you won't even save
the ones who could be saved.
I know that, but...

(The surviving ships that contacted us
are still under attack from the Vajra, too...)
rows.notes: Same as the finished S.M.S. twin c24019.

rows.en:
We'll be meeting up with the surviving ships shortly.
Pilots, stand by.

Listen up. I'm not letting a single one of you die.
We're all coming home to Frontier alive!

(I have to rescue those surviving Galaxy ships,
no matter what!)

(I don't want to believe it...
The Galaxy fleet was attacked by the Vajra...)

(Looks like the mission was a success,
but I wasn't much help...)

(And we couldn't rescue all
of the surviving Galaxy ships...)

(The mission was a success,
and I managed to do my part, but...)

(We couldn't rescue every one
of the surviving Galaxy ships...)
Looks like you made it back in one piece.

Making it back safe is good enough.
Now, let's head back to Frontier ourselves.

(I made it back alive today,
but who knows what'll happen next time...)
(I can't let my guard down from here on.)

(Looks like the mission was a success,
but I wasn't much help...)

(The mission was a success,
and I managed to do my part, but...)
(I can't let my guard down from here on.)

(Okay, time for the briefing...
I wonder what kind of mission it'll be today?)
Looks like everyone's here.
We'll now begin the mission briefing.

This mission is to destroy and investigate
a Vajra nest that's been discovered.

To stop the Vajra from multiplying, please
destroy as many Vajra eggs as you can.

Your mission also includes bringing back
samples for analysis.

I understand the mission outline.
But a mission inside a Vajra nest means...

Yes. There's a good chance the Vajra will show up,
so please carry out the demolition and survey
carefully.
Understood.
All right, we move out at once!

(I'm going to make this mission a success,
no matter what!)

(Okay, time for the briefing...
I wonder what kind of mission it'll be today?)

(I'm going to make this mission a success,
no matter what!)

(Phew... We managed to intercept the Vajra,
but I wasn't much help...)

(Phew... I'm glad we managed to intercept
the Vajra.)
Good work, \p-kun.

Oh, good work to you too,
Claire-senpai.

Looks like you worked hard.
I'm counting on you from here on out, too.
(All right! Let's keep this up!)
